evidence: The Inland Pack Track traditionally starts from the Waikori Road car park with the crossing of a large suspension bridge.
Orange markers take you back into a forested track section leading back to the Fox River car park.
The Inland Pack Track is recommended South to North following Fossil and Dilemma Creek downstream, but can also be done in reverse from the Fox River car park.

doubts: The Fox River car park end has no road-end feature, so null. The Pororari River Track access ref is the linked walk L2 (its car park has no feature). The page says the walk can also be done in reverse from the Fox River car park; recorded only in the described south-to-north direction. Bullock Creek is crossed near the old farm; the Bullock Creek Road end (F2) is an alternative access point. 'here' for the Ballroom Overhang side track is taken to be the Fox River / Dilemma Creek junction at the end of that section.
